FN-VF7MLV-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 189
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Joe Lovvorn
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/08/2023
House Bill 189 as introduced would decrease receipts to the State General Fund by
approximately $18.5 million annually, and correspondingly increase receipts to the Logging
Workforce and Forest Product Harvesting and Transportation Grant Fund, created by this bill in
the State Treasury, by the same amount by redistributing the 15% portion of the Public Utilities
License Tax, currently distributed to the State General Fund, to this new fund to be administered
by the Alabama Forestry Commission to establish a grant program to provides grants as follows:
(1) 85% for maintenance, repair, replacement, and construction of public rural bridges; and (2)
10% for support of logging workforce development and advance research and implementation
of technologies that improve forest product harvesting and transportation efficiencies. This bill
would also increase the obligations of the Commission to administer the grant program, which
would be offset, in whole or in part, by the 5% administrative holdback provided by this bill.

FN-VF7MLV-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 189
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Joe Lovvorn
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/10/2023
House Bill 189 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund would create
the Logging Efficiency Grant Fund in the State Treasury to be administered by the Alabama
Forestry Commission to fund a grant program to provide grants as follows: (1) 85% to county
commissions for maintenance, repair, replacement, and construction of public rural bridges; and
(2) 10% for support of logging workforce development and advance research and
implementation of technologies that improve forest product harvesting and transportation
efficiencies. This bill would also increase the obligations of the Commission to administer the
grant program, which would be offset, in whole or in part, by the 5% administrative holdback
provided by this bill.
